text: 2026-08-16 recovery audit exhausted the remaining read-only channels. The authors live CHI and Scientific Reports pages still advertise images.zip, raw_samples.zip, and eye_movement_events.zip; each legacy TU Berlin dataset URL returns 404. No copy was found in Internet Archive, Common Crawl 2019-2022, Arquivo.pt, global GitHub code or commit search, author/lab repository history, DepositOnce or Regensburg repositories, DataCite, Zenodo, OSF, Figshare, Hugging Face, Kaggle, URLScan, or local indexed/download/code paths. Search results only reproduce the dead author URL or paper/code placeholders. The external court cannot be run without a recovered author archive. Contacting authors is an external write and requires explicit user authorization; alternatively the user can provide eye_movement_events.zip.
